item.title: Apple Home Architecture Update: Is Your Device Compatible?
item.description: Apple has set a February 10, 2026, deadline to upgrade to the new Home architecture. Learn how to update and which older iPhones and iPads will lose access.

item.title: 2025 Becomes Apple’s Biggest Year for Services
item.description: Apple Services just had its most explosive year yet. From AI-dubbed workouts to record-breaking TV viewership, here’s how Eddy Cue and Apple redefined the "Services" era in 2025.

item.title: India Wages High-Stakes Battle with Apple over iOS Source Code
item.description: Leaked security requirements in India could force Apple to share iOS source code and allow government audits of updates. Here is why Apple and Samsung are fighting back.

item.title: Stop your iPhone from 'talking' to strangers: Change this AirPlay setting today.
item.description: Is your iPhone set to "Automatically AirPlay"? Security experts warn this default setting could leave you vulnerable to proximity-based hacks. Here’s how to secure your device.

item.title: Apple Chooses Google Gemini for Major Siri Upgrade
item.description: Is Apple sharing your data with Google? Inside the new Apple-Google AI deal: how Gemini technology is transforming Siri and what it means for your iPhone's security in iOS 26.4.

item.title: The Base M4 Chip is the New King of Mac Gaming
item.description: The December 2025 Steam Hardware Survey reveals Apple’s M4 is now the #1 chip for Mac gamers, surpassing the legendary M1. Explore the full rankings of Apple Silicon adoption and the decline of Intel Macs in our latest report.

item.title: Apple Creator Studio: Is the $129 Subscription Worth It?
item.description: Apple’s new $12.99/mo Creator Studio bundle brings Pixelmator Pro to iPad alongside Final Cut and Logic. We break down the pricing and what’s actually new.

item.title: Pixelmator for iOS is Dead: Apple Confirms No More Updates
item.description: As Pixelmator Pro arrives on iPad via the Apple Creator Studio bundle, the original Pixelmator app enters legacy status. Here is what it means for iPhone and iPad users.

item.title: iPhone 17 Ceramic Shield 2: Apple Ad & Real-World Durability
item.description: Apple’s new "Relax, it’s iPhone 17" ad puts Ceramic Shield 2 to the test. We break down the science of the slide and see how the iPhone 17 and iPhone Air fared in Allstate's drop tests.

item.title: The AI Boom Could Make Your Next iPhone Upgrade More Challenging
item.description: Will the iPhone 18 be hard to find? Rising AI demand is creating a critical component shortage for Apple. Here's what it means for your next upgrade.
